signal: CADDi raised a $38M Series C extension led by Atomico at a $470M valuation and is expanding its AI manufacturing platform across the US.

email.subject1: a signal play for CADDi's partners
email.body1:
Sam, saw CADDi raised a $38M Atomico-led extension at a $470M valuation and is pushing its AI platform across the US.

Expanding that fast usually means more partner and prospect accounts in play than the team can touch, and that is where co-sell pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem autonomously: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for CADDi's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sam, quick follow-up on the partnerships side.

A US expansion only pays off if every partner and target account actually gets worked, and that rarely scales with headcount alone. The fix is signal-to-meeting coverage that runs itself across the ecosystem, every touch auto-logged to your CRM.

I sketched a co-sell pilot playbook for CADDi's manufacturing partners. Want to grab 15 minutes and I will walk you through how it maps to your partner targets?
email.body3:
Sam, last bit of proof for CADDi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a pipeline gap analysis for your partnerships motion across the ecosystem. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through where the coverage holes are?
email.body4:
Sam, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority during the US push, no problem at all. A post-raise expansion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through three personalized drafts to your top partner targets? I will tailor them to CADDi either way.
